target.statement: FlowSteer (Ours) achieves PickScore 22.39 and HPSv2 28.60 on COCO 10k with 4 NFE on SD3-Medium, outperforming PeRFlow (22.19/26.36) and other baselines.
target.dataset: COCO 10k (1k prompts used in Table 1; 10k in Table 3)

compute.basis: Requires training a LoRA + adversarial discriminator on SD3-Medium (2B+ params) with online teacher ODE solves over Flux-Reason-6M prompts, then 4-step sampling of 10k COCO images; no code released, so the full pipeline must be reimplemented from scratch.

blockers: No code or configs released (empty code_links)
Training SD3-Medium with adversarial distillation requires GPU (24GB+ VRAM)
Online trajectory generation via teacher ODE solving is compute-heavy
Flux-Reason-6M prompt dataset is large and may need preprocessing
Reproducing the exact improved scheduler and discriminator head requires reverse-engineering from paper text
title: FlowSteer: Guiding Few-Step Image Synthesis with Authentic Trajectories
